about_the_game:
Hush... is a 2.5D multiplayer survival horror game where silence becomes your best weapon. One player takes the role of the Seeker, while up to five others must hide, escape, or outsmart them in a dark and oppressive environment. Each survivor gets a unique class with special abilities, shaping different strategies for survival, while the Seeker hunts using special classes that gives them strong abilities. With maps designed to disorient, proximity voice chat mechanics where even a whisper can betray you, and constant uncertainty lurking in every corner.

In Hush... will you survive the silence, or be the one to break it?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires keyboard and mouse. Stable internet connection needed for online play.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 TI / RTX 2060 or AMD RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DIrectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for the best experience.

short_description: Hush... is a 2.5D multiplayer survival-horror where silence is your best weapon. One player hunts as the Seeker while up to five survivors hide, mislead, and escape using class abilities, stealth, and proximity voice chat—every sound can give you away.
